regulated_notice: Operational workflow diagnostic only — not a regulatory or compliance determination. All KYC, AML, risk-rating, and account opening approvals must remain with authorised personnel. Do not enter client names or account identifiers.

questions.question: What event starts the onboarding process and what client type/product is involved?

questions.question: Who checks document completeness and authenticity, and how are gaps returned to the client?

Relationship manager requests sign-off via email

questions.question: What information and documents are collected at application?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Application form, financial statements, bank statements, collateral details...

questions.question: Who checks completeness and validates submitted information?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Credit analyst reviews pack before forwarding to underwriting officer...

questions.question: Which assessment steps are performed, and who is authorised to make credit decisions?

regulated_notice: Operational workflow diagnostic only — financial adjustments, reversals, and reconciliation sign-offs must follow dual-control and authorised finance governance.

questions.question: Which transaction records are compared and how often?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Daily bank statements vs payment gateway vs client ledger...

questions.question: What identifiers are used to match payments to customers, invoices or accounts?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Payment reference code, invoice ID, exact amount, sender account...

questions.question: How are unmatched, duplicate, delayed or reversed transactions identified?
options: Automated matching rules flag breaks daily
Finance team compares CSV exports in Excel
Discovered at month-end close or when client queries

questions.question: Who investigates each exception and what evidence is required?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Reconciliation analyst checks remittance advice and gateway logs...

questions.question: What adjustments or reversals require independent approval?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Write-offs, manual reallocations, and refunds require second finance manager approval...

questions.question: How are unresolved items aged, escalated and reported?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Items over 5 business days escalated on weekly exception report...

questions.question: How is final resolution recorded and checked against the source records?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Break closed with audit note and journal reference verified next cycle...
